summary: Elbit Systems Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release announcing the date of its second quarter 2026 financial results release on August 11, 2026, and details for a conference call. The filing is a routine earnings announcement and conference call notice by the foreign private issuer. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change is described. The filing contains no deal terms or transaction-related information. This is a standard periodic disclosure and not a special situation.
